notes: G3 spec (option 0: search count, the searched zones' controllers, the battlefield destination and its controller). Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for A Shrine card and put it ONTO THE BATTLEFIELD.' The controller chooses to search your library and graveyard; a Sanctum of Tranquil Light waits in each. The graveyard copy is picked: it enters under your control; the other stays where it was.
